arniqa.crops: centre and four corners, 224 x 224, zero-padded, at both sizes
arniqa.embedding: per crop, both sizes each L2-normalised, 4096; the mean over the crops
arniqa.precision: encoder under autocast (fp16) on the GPU, fp32 on the CPU

clipiqa.score: softmax of logit_scale x cosine; probability of the first prompt
clipiqa.weights: fp16 on the GPU (official build_model), fp32 on the CPU

labels.arniqa_proto: ARNIQA embedding vs the clean prototype (Becker et al.)
labels.global_level: Level vs the average of all clean images (stages 1–3)
labels.level: Level vs the 50 most similar clean scenes (stage-4 key)
labels.means_own: Channel means vs own average, 4 stages
labels.niqe: NIQE, pristine model refitted on clean train images
labels.peak_share: Peak share vs the 50 most similar clean scenes
labels.two_axis: Two-axis: flatter or shifted vs the 50 most similar clean scenes (headline)
